Altar of Blood – New levels

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 17:39
Instaread
As Adventurers begin their adventure into Inner Edania and their gear grows more powerful, new difficulties have been added to the Altar of Blood. The Altar of Blood’s new difficulties will go up to the 24th Illusion in this update, with plans to expand to the 27th Illusion in the future.
In addition, with these new difficulties added, we have removed the Abyssal Illusion, the challenge difficulty previously available for Adventurers who had reached the highest difficulty.
  • New higher difficulty levels, Illusions 22, 23, and 24, have been added to the Altar of Blood.
    • With the addition of a new difficulty for the Altar of Blood, the 1st to 3rd Abyssal Fantasy difficulties will be removed.
      • If you complete Abyssal Fantasy from this Sunday 00:00 until the maintenance on September 9 (Korea) or September 10 (Global), Abyssal Fantasy weekly rewards will be given via the Black Spirit’s Gift Box (B) during maintenance, separately from the existing weekly rewards for that week.

Inner Edania Trash Item Crystal Exchange

With their continued growth, more and more Adventurers have been heading to the Inner Edania monster zones, while some of the high-tier monster zones have seen fewer visitors.
The Magic Crystals obtained from those high-tier monster zones are still in steady demand, which has made them increasingly difficult to acquire.
To address this, we’re adding an exchange in Manage Currency that lets you exchange junk items obtained in the currently popular Inner Edania into key materials for some of these Magic Crystals.

  • It has been added so that you can exchange trash loot items from the Edania: Inner Monster Zones for ‘Coins of Divine Power’.

Hermesia Inner Castle Monster Zone Changes

  • The placement of subjugated slaves in specific locations has been changed.
  • Fixed an issue where nearby Subjugated Carrier Slaves were intermittently not killed along with the Subjugated Carrier Slave when the latter was killed.
  • The explosion speed has been slightly increased when a subjugated transporter slave dies while moving to offer a Black Crystal.
  • Fixed an issue where the subjugated transporter slave would awkwardly disappear during the Black Crystal offering.
  • Fixed an issue where some subjugated slaves could be struck intermittently during an intruder alert.
  • The energy of the Black Crystal has been unstable, and slaves who have submitted will now maintain a combat stance after being knocked back.
  • Fixed an issue where nearby subjugated miner slaves were intermittently not killed along with a subjugated enforcement slave while the Black Crystal’s energy was unstable.
  • The attack of Markthanan’s subordinate summoned by Markthanan’s daughter has been changed so that it fires fireballs from its position instead of charging and spitting fire.
  • Fixed an issue where Markthanan’s daughter would intermittently return to the idle stance and have her health reset.
  • Improvements have been made so that if you die during combat with Markthanan’s daughter, your health will be reset after a certain waiting period.

Other Monster Changes

  • The distance at which the <Ancient> Prophet’s Remnants monster in Tenebraum Castle returns to its original position during combat and the range at which it detects enemies have been increased.
  • Lyngbakr has been changed to gather Lyngbakr and deal damage to surrounding ships when charging energy.

Black Spirit’s Content Scheduler

The Black Spirit’s Scheduler has been added to help Adventurers track and reach their own goals more intuitively and conveniently.
With the Black Spirit’s Scheduler, you can select the content and quests you want to focus on, view them all at a glance, and easily get the help you need to complete them.
We hope the Black Spirit’s Scheduler helps you on your own special journey.
  • The ‘Black Spirit’ Content Scheduler’ has been added, allowing you to manage the schedules for daily and weekly quests as well as various content.
    • You can check the Black Spirit’s Content Scheduler in Menu (ESC) – Convenience (F8).
  • The Black Spirit’s Content Scheduler is applied on a family basis.
  • You can add schedules by pressing the + button at the top, or by directly adding a quest from the Recurring quests tab in the quest window.
    • However, recurring quests, excluding daily and weekly quests, cannot be added to the schedule.
  • You can click and drag a quest to move it to the desired list and place it.
  • To delete a quest, you can press the pin button in the list or select the quest directly from the Recurring quests tab in the quest window.
  • After the update, the content schedule is initially displayed with all items added. You can press the + button to open the settings window and turn the display of desired schedules on or off.
  • When logging in, changing characters, or switching channels, a pop-up window appears in the bottom right corner; clicking it opens the Black Spirit’s Content Scheduler

Quest Log and UI Improvements

  • The quest list has been changed so that all buttons (Abandon quest, Find Directions, Auto-Find Directions, Link) are displayed for each quest.
    • However, buttons that cannot be applied to the quest are displayed as disabled.
Before change After change
  • The remaining time displayed in the daily and weekly quest windows has been changed so that it can be checked via a description that appears when you hover the mouse, and is displayed as an icon to the left of the quest name.
  • The UI display method has been changed on the predator item selection screen of the Enhancement UI.
    • When selecting a Hunger item, only the increasing stack (the amount of the enhancement probability increase) is displayed.
    • We are preparing UI improvements to make it more intuitive to check items that increase stacks, such as Hunger items and Valks’ Cry.

System Changes

Additional optimizations have been applied to improve server stability. We will continue to monitor closely and make further improvements to ensure a stable gameplay environment.

  • Optimization work has been carried out on the process of handling the in-game time flow.
  • Optimization of World Boss spawn times has been performed.
  • The method of saving information for the currently logged-in character has been improved.
  • Optimization work has been carried out on the process of awarding Guild Fame every midnight.

Bug Fixes

  • [Shai, Agent] Fixed an issue where the Awakening Weapon slot was displayed for Shai and Agent in the Life Equipment window.
  • Fixed an issue where the hunting ground for the Scales of Judgment did not reset even after defeating the Elion’s Vengeance monster.
  • [Knowledge] Fixed an issue where the item names in the Fusion Assassination Modification Knowledge content were awkward.
  • Fixed an issue where the [Hunting] Masterpiece Matchlock and [Hunting] Marni Sniper Rifle could not be upgraded with the steadfast heart of Laulau.
  • The icon for the following Fairy Appearance Change Ticket item has been improved.
    • Requiem Fairy Appearance Change Ticket, Soul of the Dead Fairy Appearance Change Ticket, [Event] Black Spirit Fairy Appearance Change Ticket, Tick-Tock Fairy Appearance Change Ticket, Fairy Appearance Change Ticket (Park)
  • The description for the Merv’s Silver Needle item has been updated to include the explanation, “※ Using Merv’s Silver Needle resets dye information.”
  • Processing (L) – Fixed an issue where the ‘Chef’s Hat’ item could not be used as a material to craft the ‘Canapé Knot’ in the Crafting system.
  • Modified and improved so that the previous scroll position is remembered when the artifact bag is reopened.
  • Fixed an issue where beads were intermittently invisible in the ‘Tachyon’s Legacy LXIV’ quest.
  • Krogdalo, Dreamy Dinega: Fixed an issue where the movement distance of the Instant Acceleration skill was slightly shortened when moving in water or desert.
  • The Krio Fishing Chair, which can be crafted at the Woodworking Workshop Level 3, has been changed to the Krio Fishing Chair (3 days) Box.
  • Fixed an issue where the skill effect (Combat Experience Gain +100%) was applied to other servers in certain situations when using ‘Honorable Golden Bell’ in the [Guild (G) – Guild Skills] tab.
  • Fixed an issue where the Pad Mode key guide appeared when hovering the mouse over Agris Essence in the Alchemy Stone Polishing/Growth UI.
  • Fixed an issue where the sorting order of items stored in the warehouse would intermittently change when using the warehouse with auto-sorting enabled.
  • Fixed an issue where the <Refined> Straight Arrow monster in Aresion Temple was visible before it appeared.
  • Fixed an issue where the maximum number of participants in the World Map (M) Base Battle information varied depending on the time.
  • Fixed an issue where some item information was missing from the main reward information for Boss Bell in the Boss Information UI.
  • Fixed an issue where the name of the Sailing/Trading section in the Life Equipment Information UI was displayed as “Sailing.”
  • The description regarding the energy consumption effects of gathering/cultivation in the My Info (P) window has been modified to be identical.
  • Fixed an issue where some environmental graphics, such as clouds and shadows, were displayed unnaturally.
  • [Pad Mode] Fixed an issue where an X button was displayed in the upper right corner of the popup when automatically adding to the current warehouse or the entire warehouse.
  • [Pad Mode] Fixed an issue where the Life Equipment Information tab could not be opened in the Equipment window.
  • [Pad Mode] Fixed an issue where the Life Tool slot icon was displayed awkwardly in the Life Equipment Information tab of the Equipment window.
  • [Pad Mode] Fixed an issue where only the armor icon changed when equipping life gear.
  • [Pad Mode] Fixed an issue where the durability warning notification for life gathering tools was not being displayed.
  • [Pad Mode] Fixed an issue where the use of Alchemy Stones remained in the menu items of the Ring Menu Settings.
  • [Pad Mode] Modified so that a comma is displayed in the “My Stats” section of the World Map Base Battle stat limit explanation.
  • [Pad Mode] Fixed an issue where the auto-use check button remained on the right side of the alchemy stone.

Class Changes

Sorceress

Sorceress Succession is a class that can apply CC to multiple enemies from range and then close the gap to continue fighting in melee once an opening appears. However, as her ranged damage was slightly too high, adjustments have been made.

  • The PVP damage of the following skills has been changed.
Skill name Before change After change
Prime: Dream of Doom
48.25% damage applied before charging is complete in PVP
Damage application rate 51.06% upon completion of charge in PVP
Damage application rate before charging is 43.43% in PVP
Damage application rate upon completion of charge in PVP: 45.96%
Prime: Abyssal Flame
44.17% damage application rate for normal attacks in PVP
Damage application rate of Charged Strike in PVP: 48.58%
39.55% damage application rate for normal attacks in PVP
43.5% damage application rate for Charged Strike in PVP

Valkyrie

Valkyrie Succession has a playstyle that supports allies through her attacks and recoveries. However, the Damage Reduction from Guard and her passive skill, combined with the immunity to All Damage Reduction debuffs from Succession: Absolute: Heaven’s Echo, allowed her to stay in combat with relatively little risk, so adjustments have been made.

Succession: Absolute: Heaven’s Echo
  • The following effects of the skill have been removed.
    • Removes All Damage Reduction debuffs when using the skill.
    • Nullifies All Damage Reduction debuffs for 20 sec.

Kunoichi

Prime: Shadow Stomp
  • It has been improved so that when used in conjunction with other skills, the Ninjutsu buff effect is immediately obtained.

Archer

We have adjusted Archer’s Special Attack Damage during his 3-min buff, which was somewhat high compared to his normal state.
